Class ReadMappingBuilder<TRow>

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Serialization.Generated
Assembly
ParquetNeo.Serialization.dll

Describes how a row type is read from columns, and gets the code that creates each object from their values. What the source generator writes for a type uses it, and nothing at run time looks at the type: no reflection, and no code is compiled. Not for use in code you write yourself.

public sealed class ReadMappingBuilder<TRow>

Remarks

The properties are described in the same way as for a WriteMappingBuilder<TRow>: in the order of their columns, depth first, with a Begin call and End() around what is inside an object, a collection or a dictionary.
